title: Effectsaidan
description: Server-wide buff system with 17 effects, beacon GUI, and EmeraldBank economy integration
body:
# ⚔️ Effectsaidan - Server-Wide Buff System

## 🌟 Overview

Effectsaidan provides a comprehensive buff system where players can purchase server-wide effects using emeralds. With 17 different effects and a beautiful beacon-style GUI!

## ✨ 17 Powerful Effects

### Base Effects (7 types)
- EXP Boost - 2x experience (1.5x cost)
- Saturation - No hunger (0.5x cost)
- Attack Boost - 2x damage (2.0x cost)
- Drop Rate - 2x drops (2.5x cost)
- Regeneration - Auto heal (2.5x cost)
- Resistance II - Less damage (3.0x cost)
- Haste II - Fast mining (1.8x cost)

### Potion Effects (7 types)
- Speed II - Move faster (1.5x cost)
- Night Vision - See in dark (1.2x cost)
- Water Breathing - Underwater (1.8x cost)
- Fire Resistance - No fire damage (2.0x cost)
- Jump Boost II - Jump higher (1.3x cost)
- Luck - Better loot (3.0x cost)
- Invisibility - Become invisible (5.0x cost)

### Custom Effects (3 types)
- Mob Loot Boost - 2x+ mob drops (2.8x cost)
- Emerald Finder - Find emeralds (3.5x cost)
- Auto Repair - Fix equipment (4.0x cost)

## 🎮 Features
- Beacon-Style GUI (54 slots)
- Level System (up to Level 5)
- EmeraldBank Integration
- Server-wide effects
- Persistent through restarts

## 📋 Commands
- `/aidan open` - Open effect shop

## 📦 Requirements
- Paper/Spigot 1.21+
- EmeraldBank (Required!)
- Java 21+
